card.name: Linking words in RAS drug lists
card.fires_on: Small linking words or commas in lists of renin-angiotensin drugs, right before the next class name such as ACE inhibitors, ARBs or aliskiren.

modes.label: List joiner
modes.description: A comma, "or" or "including" between angiotensin receptor blockers and ACE inhibitors.
modes.example: Dual blockade of the RAS with angiotensin receptor blockers<<,>> ACE inhibitors or

modes.label: Before the system name
modes.description: A word just before renin-angiotensin or another RAS drug name.
modes.example: Drugs that inhibit<< the>> renin-angiotensin system
